zeroconf_confirm.title: Found PiDP-11
zeroconf_confirm.description:
Found a PiDP-11 emulator at **{host}:{port}**.

Enter the shared secret to complete setup. Retrieve it on the Pi by running:
```
sudo docker exec pidp11 cat /data/remote_console.secret
```

user.title: Connect to PiDP-11 add-on
user.description:
Point this integration at the PiDP-11 emulator add-on's remote-console port.

{secret_hint}

data_description.host: IP or hostname of the machine running the PiDP-11 add-on
data_description.remote_console_port: Port mapped to the add-on's authshim (default 2223)
data_description.shared_secret: 64-character secret. On the Pi run: sudo docker exec pidp11 cat /data/remote_console.secret (Topology A fills it in automatically)

reconfigure.title: Change the PiDP-11 shared secret
reconfigure.description:
Enter the new shared secret for the PiDP-11 at **{host}:{port}**. Get it on the Pi with:
```
sudo docker exec pidp11 cat /data/remote_console.secret
```

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the remote console.
error.invalid_auth: Shared secret rejected by the add-on.

init.title: PiDP-11 options
init.description: Lower poll intervals and higher lamp rates load the Pi and the phone more. 10 fps is the recommended lamp rate; more than 20 fps is excessive.

data_description.poll_interval_seconds: How often the integration reads the CPU state and registers, 1 to 60 seconds. Default 5.
data_description.lamp_fps: How many times per second the front panel lamps are updated, 5 to 20. Default and recommended: 10.
